- [FACT] User works an average of 40 hours a week.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended smartwatches compatible with Android: 
  1. **Samsung Galaxy Watch** (42mm, 46mm): Up to 4 days of battery life, features heart rate monitoring, GPS, sleep tracking, stress tracking, integration with Samsung Health, priced around $300-$350.
  2. **Fossil Gen 5** (42mm, 44mm): Up to 24 hours of battery life (extendable to 12 days with Power Reserve mode), features heart rate monitoring, GPS, sleep tracking, integration with Google Fit, priced around $295-$315.
  3. **Mobvoi TicWatch E2**: Up to 2 days of battery life (extendable to 30 days with Power Saver mode), features heart rate monitoring, GPS, sleep tracking, integration with Google Fit, priced around $160-$180.
  4. **Huawei Watch GT 2** (42mm, 46mm): Up to 2 weeks of battery life, features heart rate monitoring, GPS, sleep tracking, integration with Huawei Health, priced around $150-$200.
  5. **Garmin Venu**: Up to 5 days of battery life (extendable to 12 days with Power Saver mode), features heart rate monitoring, GPS, sleep tracking, integration with Garmin Connect, priced around $250-$300.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider when choosing a smartwatch: fitness features, design and style, compatibility, and budget.
